---
title: "SCOP 故障排查决策指南"
description: "按阶段排查 input、layers、QC、doublets、integration、annotation、pseudobulk、optional backends、figures、manifests 与 spatial coordinates。"
---

排错应保留第一处失败证据。修改 package 或 workflow 前记录 exact call、complete error、input checkpoint、object audit 和 session information。修复最早破坏的 contract，后续症状常会一起消失。

::: {.learning-objectives}
## 学习目标

你将学会：

1. 将错误定位在 import、object、QC、construction、integration、annotation、inference、spatial 或 publication；
2. 收集最小 diagnostic bundle；
3. 区分 invalid input 与 missing backend；
4. 避免隐藏 failed sample、覆盖 counts 或强迫结果；
5. 定义问题真正解决的证据。
:::

## 1 · 从最早 failed gate 开始

| 阶段 | 必须通过 | 不应继续 |
|---|---|---|
| input | checksum、dimensions、IDs、reader | wrong file、mixed trio、orientation unknown |
| object | counts、sparse、metadata alignment | counts missing、duplicate cells、misalignment |
| QC | per-sample distributions/retention | sample collapse 或 thresholds 不明 |
| construction | joined layers、dims、graphs、stable clusters | wrong reduction/graph |
| integration | source mixing + biology preservation | overcorrection/confounding/no overlap |
| annotation | marker/reference consensus | forced label/reference mismatch |
| inference | biological replication/design | cells as replicates/wrong coefficient |
| spatial | coordinate/image/sample | mirrored/mixed coordinates |
| publication | manifest/hashes/SCOP provenance/rendered QA | stale/non-SCOP figure |

## 2 · Minimal diagnostic bundle

```r
diagnose_srt <- function(srt) {
  assay <- DefaultAssay(srt)
  layers <- Layers(srt[[assay]])
  counts <- if ("counts" %in% layers) {
    LayerData(srt, assay = assay, layer = "counts")
  } else NULL

  list(
    dimensions = dim(srt),
    class = class(srt),
    assays = Assays(srt),
    default_assay = assay,
    layers = layers,
    sparse_counts = if (is.null(counts)) NA else inherits(counts, "sparseMatrix"),
    cell_names_unique = !anyDuplicated(colnames(srt)),
    feature_names_unique = !anyDuplicated(rownames(srt)),
    metadata_rows_match = identical(rownames(srt[[]]), colnames(srt)),
    metadata = colnames(srt[[]]),
    reductions = Reductions(srt),
    graphs = Graphs(srt),
    images = Images(srt),
    commands = names(srt@commands),
    tools = names(srt@tools)
  )
}
diagnose_srt(srt)
sessionInfo()
```

```r
writeLines(conditionMessage(error_object), "artifacts/last-error.txt")
saveRDS(srt, "artifacts/failing-input.rds")
```

对象含敏感数据时只保存到 approved protected location。UMAP screenshot 不是 diagnostic bundle。

## 3 · Input failures

| 现象 | 第一证据 | 原因 | 修复 | 通过证据 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Read10X()` 缺文件 | directory listing | level/name 错 | 恢复标准三件套 | expected dimensions |
| features 与 matrix rows 不同 | headers/dim | 跨 sample 混文件 | 重新获取一致 trio | 三者一致 |
| H5 返回 list | `names(raw)` | multi-feature | 选 RNA 且保留其他 modality | 每 modality 有 assay audit |
| H5 hash 不同 | SHA-256 | partial/wrong/update | 停止识别 source | checksum 匹配 |
| text import 内存暴涨 | class/file size | dense | 回到 H5/MTX/sparse | `sparseMatrix` |
| “counts” 有负数/小数 | summary/provenance | normalized/log/scale | 重新获取 raw 或限制方法 | layer contract |
| duplicate features | IDs/symbols | symbol collisions | stable IDs/mapping | unique + mapping |
| metadata `NA` | barcode join | suffix/prefix mismatch | one-to-one keys | 无意外 missing |

不能用截断 matrix 或循环 metadata 修复 dimension mismatch。

## 4 · Assay/layer failures

```r
Assays(srt)
DefaultAssay(srt)
Layers(srt[[DefaultAssay(srt)]])
```

有 split source layers 时有计划地：

```r
srt <- JoinLayers(srt)
stopifnot("counts" %in% Layers(srt[[DefaultAssay(srt)]]))
```

若原来没有 counts，JoinLayers 不能创造。不能把 normalized `data` 复制成 `counts`。

Wrong default assay 会让 marker 使用 SCT/integrated/peaks。每个 method 前明确：

```r
DefaultAssay(srt) <- "RNA"
stopifnot("counts" %in% Layers(srt[["RNA"]]))
```

搜索 full matrix 附近的 `as.matrix()`；只有小型教学 subset 才可接受。

## 5 · QC/doublet/contamination

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| QC 删除某 sample 多数 cells | failed library/global threshold | 单独检查并记录决定 |
| rerun retained count 变化 | threshold/seed/version drift | 比较 cell-name sets/manifest |
| mitochondrial % 全接近 0 | species/regex 错 | 检查 IDs 并用正确 pattern |
| doublet runner 拒绝 | normalized input/too few/backend | 回 raw counts，per library 运行 |
| 各 library doublet rate 完全相同 | global call | 按 library 重跑 |
| decontamination 删除 known markers | overcorrection/background 错 | 比较 original/corrected，必要时停止 |
| QC plot 与 threshold 不一致 | stale plot/metadata | 从同一 checkpoint 重建 `FeatureStatPlot()` |

解决证据：before/after SCOP plot、retained table/sample、exclusion reasons、unchanged original-count checkpoint。

## 6 · Dimension/clustering/UMAP

`RunDimsEstimate()` 找不到 reduction：

```r
Reductions(srt)
Embeddings(srt, "pca")[1:3, 1:3]
```

先运行所需 linear reduction 并使用准确名称。不能把 UMAP 当 linear reduction。

`ClusterTreePlot()` 为空：

```r
grep("_snn_res\\.", colnames(srt[[]]), value = TRUE)
```

需要 resolution grid 和实际 prefix；一个 resolution 不能产生 tree。

UMAP 大幅改变时比较 reduction、dimensions、seed、neighbours、versions、cell names。使用 structural metrics，而不是只做 pixel comparison。

## 7 · Integration failures

| 现象 | 含义 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| Harmony 后 cell types 混在一起 | overcorrection | 减弱 correction/改 batch 或停止 |
| batches 仍分开 | true biology/no overlap/undercorrection | 检查 shared types/features，不强迫 mixing |
| condition effect 消失 | confounding/overcorrection | 回到 design，不 integrate 掉 target |
| rare type 只在一 source | source biology/artefact | separate/report limited support |
| 有 integrated reduction 但 plot 用 PCA | wrong reduction | 明确传入 SCOP reduction |

必须比较 pre/post source mixing、cell-type preservation、markers、composition、cluster structure。

## 8 · Annotation failures

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 所有 cells 高置信 | closed vocabulary | 查 out-of-reference，保留 unknown |
| T/NK 或 Mono/DC 互换 | shared programmes | 要求 positive + contradictory evidence |
| within-dataset transfer 极好 | leakage/shared preprocessing | 独立验证并诚实报告 internal test |
| `RunLabelTransfer()` 要 ChromatinAssay | RNA query 走错 multiome path | RNA anchors/correct assay |
| SingleR load 失败 | package/reference 缺 | 安装/version 或 `not executed` |
| fine label cells 太少 | resolution unsupported | 合并 broad 或 uncertain |
| label 只在 failed sample | artefact | 审查 QC/markers/doublets/reference |

解决证据是 consensus table、marker heatmap、confidence/uncertainty、cross-sample audit。

## 9 · Pseudobulk/composition

```r
design <- unique(srt[[]][c("sample_id", "condition")])
table(design$condition)
```

每组一个 independent sample 时停止 inference。Design matrix rank：

```r
X <- model.matrix(~ batch + condition, data = design)
c(rank = qr(X)$rank, columns = ncol(X))
```

Rank deficiency 通常是 confounding/redundancy。不能仅为了得到 condition coefficient 删除必要 batch。检查 factor levels/coefficient direction，并报告每个 `sample × cell type` 的 cells/counts 和 sensitivity。

## 10 · Optional backend failures

```r
backend_status <- c(
  SingleR = requireNamespace("SingleR", quietly = TRUE),
  celldex = requireNamespace("celldex", quietly = TRUE),
  spacexr = requireNamespace("spacexr", quietly = TRUE),
  zellkonverter = requireNamespace("zellkonverter", quietly = TRUE),
  loomR = requireNamespace("loomR", quietly = TRUE)
)
backend_status
```

记录 runner/error、missing resource/model、env/version、失败发生在 result 前还是后、`not executed/failed` status 和 unblock 条件。不能用 synthetic values 画 placeholder。

## 11 · Spatial failures

| 现象 | 检查 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| mirrored/shifted | image key/coords/ranges | 声明 coordinate system 并验证 landmarks |
| graph 跨 slices 连边 | sample/image | per-slice graph 或 block edges |
| Moran genes 跟 depth | `nCount_Spatial` correlation | 检查 QC/depth 并限制解释 |
| neighbourhood result 找不到 | `tool_name`/`srt@tools` | store/plot 使用同一名称 |
| RCTD unavailable | `spacexr` | 安装验证或 not executed |
| deconvolution 不合理 | reference mismatch | compatible reference + markers |
| one section 当 patient replicates | `sample_id` table | 限制 descriptive spot-level |

## 12 · Figure/publication failures

若图不是 SCOP-native，检查 manifest 的 `plot_function`，只能由 `scop::...` plotters 组成；通过相关 SCOP function 重建。Manifest hash mismatch 表示 figure/component 在 manifest 后改变，必须 rebuild evidence，不能手改 hash，并查看 source-resolution image。

Render failure 时运行 `quarto render`，修复具体 source line，再检查 internal links、image paths、alt、paired Chinese route，最后检查 desktop/mobile。Source 成功不保证 legend/table 可读。

::: {.checkpoint}
**解决检查点**

只有 original minimal reproduction 通过、object invariants 保持、numeric/biological evidence 恢复、manifests/hashes 有效，并查看实际 SCOP output，才算解决。若 analysis 静默改变，仅“error 消失”不够。
:::

::: {.exercise}
## 练习

选一个最近 error，写 failing stage、exact call、checkpoint、diagnostic bundle、earliest violated contract、smallest repair、resolution proof 和 claim impact。若 fix 改变 independent unit 或删除 sample，应升级为 scientific decision。
:::

::: {.boundary}
Troubleshooting 能恢复 intended computation，但不能挽救 unidentifiable design、缺 biological replication、不合适 reference 或 absent ground truth。
:::
